BEFORE THE BOARD OF OIL, GAS AND MINING
DEPARTMENT OF NATURAL RESOURCES AND ENERGY
IN AND FOR THE STATE OF UTAH

IN THE MATTER OF THE PETITION *
OF TXO PRODUCTION CORPORATION * ORDER
FOR AN ORDER PERMITTING THE *
RE-ENTRY AND PRODUCTION OF THE * Docket No.
VALENTINE FEDERAL # 1 WELL ad Cause No.
LOCATED IN SECTION 35, TOWNSHIP *
16 SOUTH, RANGE 25 EAST, S.L.M. *

On January 25, 1988, TXO Production Corporation filed
the above captioned Petition and concurrently therewith moved
this Board to set such matter for hearing on February 25, 1988.

Said motion is hereby granted.

DATED this lst day of February, 1988.

BOARD OF OIL, GAS AND MINING
—L out Clans, Chairman
